versions.subject: Rules for detecting changes in the storage paths of evtx logs
versions.detection:
selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '.evtx'
filter1:
    TargetFilename|contains: 'Windows\System32\WinEVT\Logs\'
filter2:
    Image: "C:\\Windows\\Explorer.EXE"
filter3:
    Image: "C:\\Windows\\system32\\DllHost.exe"
condition: selection and not filter1 and not filter2 and not filter3
